description: Public fixed-speed Z-contoured wall deposition preserves nominal layer bounds and minimum thickness.

mutants.description: Flatten every fixed-speed contoured deposition endpoint to nominal layer height. Earlier travel to a path start cannot satisfy the requirement for lowered wall extrusion.

Reverse the fixed-speed Z correction. Lowered roof walls must remain below the nominal layer height and retain at least the configured minimum thickness; an upward correction fails the physical output bound.
